summary: Aklan 1st District representative with 145 principal-authored bills. Authored a single-use plastics excise; co-authored employment anti-discrimination for women. One issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
